name: migrate
description: Replace an existing system layer by layer until the new application is complete. Extends /setup, run once at start.

steps.name: Prerequisites and scope protection
steps.instruction: Verify /setup ran (SCOPE.md, ARCHITECTURE.md, CLAUDE.md exist). Read scope docs and endpoint registries. All source features IN unless explicitly cut with reason and owner. Parity system (entity registries, endpoint maps) is authoritative scope if exists.
checklist: All source features IN unless explicitly cut

steps.name: Phase dispatch
steps.instruction: Read Active Workflow from CLAUDE.md for current phase. Route to phases/{NN}-{name}.md. 7 phases: docs sprint, vertical slice, horizontal buildout, integration, functional validation, design pass, cutover. No workflow record -> start phase 1, write record.

steps.name: Wrapup and phase advance
steps.instruction: At phase boundaries: suggest /wrapup. Evaluate gate criteria from phase file. Pass -> advance phase in CLAUDE.md, announce next. Fail -> list unmet, propose work. Final phase (cutover) -> mark completed with date.
checklist: Gate evaluated, phase advanced or gaps listed

tone: Methodical. Every feature in the source system is accounted for.
